risks.risk: Camera does not power on or function.
risks.proof: Video of the camera powering on, navigating menus, taking a photo, and reviewing it.

risks.risk: Model is unreadable; wrong model assumed.
risks.proof: Clear photo of the model name/number on the camera front or top.

risks.risk: High shutter count or heavy usage.
risks.proof: Screenshot of shutter count from the camera menu or a shutter-count reading from a sample photo.

risks.risk: Sensor, mirror, or lens glass has scratches, fungus, or haze.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the sensor (mirror up), mirror, and front/rear lens glass under bright light.

risks.risk: Battery, charger, box, manuals, or memory card missing.
risks.proof: Photo of all included accessories together.

risks.risk: Autofocus or metering does not perform.

risks.risk: Age unknown and out of warranty.
risks.proof: Original purchase receipt or warranty card.
risks.if_unproven: as out of warranty with unknown age

proof_requests: Clear photo of the camera model name/number (front or top).
Video of the camera powering on, taking a photo, and reviewing it.
Close-up photos of lens glass, sensor, and mirror under light.
Photo of all included accessories (battery, charger, box, manuals, memory card).
Screenshot or sample photo to verify shutter count.
